correctness.rationale: The weighted graph enumeration is exhaustive (single shore or subsets of one deleted triple). It gives Z, A, B and z^2F exactly. For n=3 F has nonnegative coefficients and a positive linear term. For n=4 its nonzero coefficients have one sign variation for all 1<=k<=4. For n>=5 the cubic and quartic coefficients are strictly negative under k<=n; all higher coefficients are strictly negative by monotonicity of binomial ratios and an explicit negative fifth coefficient. F/z therefore has one sign variation, F starts positive and has a negative highest coefficient; Descartes gives one simple positive crossing. A uniform expansion at z=x/n near the simple limit root log 2 proves the stated two-term correction and covariance limit. The independent exact checker passes 12464 assertions; it is not used as an infinite-family proof.

value.rationale: A naturally compatible nonedge pair in a repulsive three-sublattice gas experiences positive dilute mediated correlation and negative single-shore competition at larger fugacity. The exact exceptional-size boundary, all-size single crossing, universal log(2)/n scale and defect-density second correction are mathematically motivated structural information unavailable from the baseline partition polynomial alone; no arbitrary parameter slice or mere tiny numeric improvement is involved.
